note: baseline, the wall of fixtures and both disruptor arms are REAL runs of the deck's own kernel (90 s windows, seed schedule of pipeline/70_simulate.mjs; baseline parity-checked against sim.json.ensemble.before). Every ball path the deck animates was simulated here and stored — the browser replays, it does not simulate. The disruptor is SYNTHETIC — no such athlete was measured. U and E are stated constructs, printed as formulas. The identification table reads MEASURED metrics through a stated rule.

protocol.seed_schedule: 20160320 + 100003 + 7·i — the same block for every fixture

duel.note: both sides are cards the wall already scored, re-run on the SAME window each card was replaying, with recording on. The boards animate ONE 90 s window each — an illustration. Every number on the plate is over that fixture's whole 240-window block.
